task: Cross-model extension (Exp 5 anatomy + Exp 6 LiM scan + Exp 7 gradient interference) of the tied_vs_untied empirical validation; 6 local models, physical GPU 1
notes: Per-model dtype: fp32 where the fp32 peak fits 15.93 GiB VRAM on GPU 1; bf16 otherwise (qwen2.5-3b — weights + full hidden-state capture exceed VRAM in fp32; qwen3-4b and gemma — fp32 weights do not fit).
Exp6 lengths per model are capped by max_position_embeddings and VRAM: 8k skipped for qwen2.5-3b / qwen3-4b (fp32 peak exceeds VRAM; user spec 'если не влезает — пропусти').

Exp6 protocol = E4f: positions [0.05, 0.25, 0.45, 0.75, 0.95], 2 reps (filler offsets [0, 150]); Inversion Contrast = Mean Lift(middle) - Mean Lift(edges); > 0 inverted-U (middle better), < 0 classic U / LiM.

Exp7 protocol = the ORIGINAL exp1 decomposition (G_total / G_in with a frozen lm_head clone / G_out from no-grad hidden states + fresh W'), uniform for all six models: even the gemma composite wrapper's built-in CE loss is differentiable (probe v2), so out.loss.backward() is used everywhere; only module resolution differs (gemma text stack = model.language_model, vision tower excluded). N_GRAD_TOKENS=128.
Original control-pair reference: Qwen2.5-0.5B (tied) cos(G_in,G_out)=+0.018, ||G_out||/||G_in||=3.754; TinyLlama-1.1B (untied) cos(G_emb,G_lm)=+0.001, ratio 0.998.
